stemMd: Which statement is the logical negation of “Every participant submitted at least one form”?

options.label: A
options.textMd: At least one participant submitted no forms.

options.label: B
options.textMd: Every participant submitted exactly one form.

options.label: D
options.textMd: At least one participant submitted a form.

explanationMd: To refute a universal claim, find one counterexample. A counterexample here is a participant who did not submit at least one form, meaning zero forms. The negation does not require every participant to have failed.

distractorRationale.c: This is stronger than the negation; one exception is enough.
distractorRationale.b: This can satisfy the original rather than negate it.
distractorRationale.e: Two forms still satisfy at least one.
distractorRationale.d: This is compatible with the original claim.
